title: Premises and permitted use
check: Confirm the premises, permitted use and practical access.
tip: Visit at your busiest time. Check parking, deliveries, lifts and internet availability, then ask your solicitor to confirm that the permitted use covers your activities.

title: Starting and finishing
check: Record commencement, expiry and any conditions before occupation.
tip: Put access, fitout, moving and trading dates on one timeline. Confirm when rent starts and who carries the cost if approvals or landlord works are delayed.

title: Your option notice window
check: Read when and how an option notice must be served.
tip: Copy the exact notice window and delivery method from the lease. Set reminders before it opens and nominate one person to confirm notice has been received.

title: Rent and outgoings
check: Check whether rent is gross or net and what sits outside it.
tip: Request an itemised outgoings estimate. Add rent, outgoings, GST, utilities, parking and cleaning to a monthly budget so you compare spaces on the same basis.

title: Rent reviews
check: Understand fixed, CPI and market rent review wording.
tip: Ask for a year-by-year rent schedule and model more than one review scenario. Have your solicitor explain any minimum increase and market review dispute process.

title: Incentives in writing
check: Document rent-free periods, landlord works and contributions.
tip: Record amounts, payment dates and conditions in the final documents. Check whether outgoings continue during rent-free periods and whether incentives can be clawed back.

title: Fitout responsibilities
check: Confirm who pays for approvals, fitout and building works.
tip: Build one budget for works, approvals, furniture, IT and moving. Identify who obtains each approval and get written scope and quotes before committing.

title: Repairs and insurance
check: Understand maintenance, repair and insurance responsibilities.
tip: List responsibility for air-conditioning, lifts and other equipment. Ask about service records and replacement costs, then check the insurance requirements with your broker.

title: Make-good at the end
check: Assess exit obligations and record the ingoing condition.
tip: Agree a dated photo condition report before taking possession. Get an early estimate of removal and reinstatement costs, then ask your solicitor to clarify the exit clause.

title: Changes during the lease
check: Read assignment, subletting, relocation and demolition clauses.
tip: Consider a growing team, downsizing or selling the business. Ask your solicitor what approvals, costs and notice apply if your needs change or the landlord relocates you.

title: Security and signing
check: Check deposits, bank guarantees, personal guarantees and authority.
tip: Ask your bank how security affects available cash. Confirm the amount and release conditions, and have your solicitor explain any personal exposure before signing.

title: The final legal review
check: Have your solicitor check the final lease against agreed terms.
tip: Keep a single list of agreed commercial terms and unresolved questions. Send it with the final documents to your solicitor so verbal promises and negotiated changes can be checked.
